A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 34-page versions of the same work, Neural ODE Transformers, including Appendices A-F. Text and visual comparisons support reliable matching throughout.

before.justification: v1 reports original language-modeling and fine-tuning experiments in Section 6, plus downstream evaluations, simulations, ablations and model analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including perplexity results in Tables 1-2, downstream evaluations in Tables 4-5, and appendix simulations and ablations.

M1.justification: The DIFFEQFORMER time-dependent weight architecture, Lyapunov sensitivity procedure and adaptive fine-tuning procedure remain unchanged in Sections 4-6 and Appendices A-B.

E1.justification: Both versions use WikiText103 and OpenWebText for language modeling and transfer in both directions, together with the same downstream benchmarks and trajectory-simulation scenarios in Appendix C.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: GPT and shared-parameter models in Table 1, GPT and Llama-1B in Table 2, and GPT-large/Llama-1B in Tables 4-5. Fine-tuning and appendix analysis comparators also match.

E3.justification: Data splits, model configurations, optimizer settings, batch sizes and evaluation metrics are unchanged. Both versions retain the same zero-shot/five-shot evaluations and Section 6.2 fine-tuning configurations.

E4.justification: Optimizer sensitivity in C.5, trajectory simulations in C.8, embedding and architecture ablations in D, spectral analyses in E, and Lyapunov sensitivity examples in F are retained without changes.

E5.justification: Uncertainty reporting in Tables 4-5 and Figures 9-12 and statistical-significance statements in Appendix C.7 are unchanged. No run-count, seed or statistical-procedure disclosures are added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical results, plotted findings and qualitative examples match throughout. For example, Table 2 reports perplexities of 15.43 for Our model-large and 9.68 for Our Llama-1B in both versions; appendix results also match.

T1.justification: The ODE definitions and spectral reasoning in Sections 4-5, Lyapunov and Jacobian derivations in Appendix B, and simulation equations in C.8 are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about time-dependent neural ODE transformers, internal-dynamics analysis, competitive performance and flexible fine-tuning across architectural configurations.

C2.justification: Interpretations of spectral growth, clustering, token sensitivity and optimizer behavior are unchanged. The conclusion's memory-efficiency and future-work qualifications and Appendix F's sensitivity caveat are also retained.

D1.justification: Implementation and source-code access information, hyperparameters and hardware in Appendix C, and inference and memory details in Appendix D are unchanged. The reproducibility statement and external link targets also match.

R1.justification: Related-work positioning and the cited works are unchanged. Some reference entries shift between pages after the expanded acknowledgment, but no works are added or removed.

P1.justification: Duc Nguyen and Toan Tran's affiliations change from Movian AI to Qualcomm AI Research, with updated emails and a Qualcomm Vietnam footnote. The acknowledgments add Korea University's New Faculty Settlement Research Fund, mentioning it twice. Scientific prose and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The affiliation footnote and expanded acknowledgments cause limited text reflow on pages 1-3 and 11-14. Figures 1-29 and Tables 1-6 retain their content, formatting and placement; all appendix pages render identically.

improvement.justification: v2 updates affiliations, contact details and funding attribution, with minor layout shifts. Methods, evidence, mathematical reasoning, reproducibility information and limitations remain unchanged, including the appendices. These administrative edits do not materially improve or weaken the paper's overall quality.
